causal_availability.cost_uses: entry and exit transaction-local cost evidence is applied only after the corresponding execution boundary exists; it never controls event admission
causal_availability.decision_uses: current completed event bar plus the preceding 24 strictly consecutive M5 bars only
causal_availability.entry_uses: pending intent fills only when the first later observed M5 open arrives
causal_availability.exit_uses: 30-minute target is scheduled at entry and settles only when an observed M5 open at or after target arrives
causal_availability.sample_end: unfilled pending entry/open trade at capture end is right-censored and never retroactively changes signal admission

cost_state.rule: Every admitted Stage-A execution must bind a TRANSACTION_LOCAL_COST_RESOLVED row from the accepted hash-bound NETH25 capture; any admitted unresolved row halts before economic outcome opening. Suppressed signals do not require execution cost because they are rejected solely by prior active-state causality.

direction.LONG: completed event closes below prior_24_low and current_range >= 1.5 * prior_24_median_range
direction.NO_OP: otherwise, or fewer than 24 prior strictly consecutive M5 bars, or candidate already has an active/pending NETH25 position
direction.SHORT: completed event closes above prior_24_high and current_range >= 1.5 * prior_24_median_range

entry.price: first later observed NETH25 M5 open after the completed event; admission never queries future return or exit price

execution_assumptions.cost_model: hash-bound transaction-local entry+exit spread and broker-native commission price-equivalent; any admitted trade lacking a resolved cost blocks outcome opening
execution_assumptions.missing_bars: market-closure gaps are preserved; no synthetic or forward-filled prices
execution_assumptions.ohlc_execution_proxy: M5 OPEN at the prospectively defined entry and exit settlement timestamps

exit.market_closure_semantics: wait for first later observed M5 open; never suppress an admitted trade based on future exit availability
exit.price: first observed NETH25 M5 open at or after entry_timestamp_plus_30_minutes

features.formula: maximum high across the immediately preceding 24 strictly consecutive M5 bars
features.name: prior_24_high

features.formula: minimum low across the immediately preceding 24 strictly consecutive M5 bars
features.name: prior_24_low

features.formula: median(high-low) across the immediately preceding 24 strictly consecutive M5 bars
features.name: prior_24_median_range

provenance.selection_basis: EPOCH17 AGGREGATE 40-SYMBOL REVERSAL PERSISTENCE PLUS EPOCH18 EUR200 REALIZABILITY AND PRE-OUTCOME NETH25 FRICTION_PASS/COST-EVIDENCE AVAILABILITY; NO NETH25 RETURN OR PNL USED

rationale: Prospectively test whether the aggregate reversal persistence observed at fixed 15m and 30m horizons generalizes economically to one EUR200-feasible, pre-outcome friction-pass broker-native index using a fixed breakout-expansion law, causal next-open entry, fixed 30-minute scheduled exit, candidate-specific same-symbol no-overlap, and hash-bound transaction-local costs. The identity is deliberately narrow and cannot close the family or the 1578-symbol frontier.
